description: This file defines the DrupalElementStyleCommand class, a CKEditor5 plugin command for applying Drupal-specific element styles within the editor. It manages style definitions, retrieves current style states, and applies or removes styles on selected elements.

classes.name: DrupalElementStyleCommand
classes.description: A CKEditor5 command class for managing Drupal element styles, including applying, retrieving, and updating style attributes on model elements.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the command with editor instance and style definitions, preparing internal style maps and model attributes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the command's enabled state and current value based on the selected element's style attributes.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current style values for a given element, defaulting to style defaults if attributes are missing.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Applies or removes a specified style attribute on the selected model element based on provided options.
